code='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    cells={(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==8}
    # Identify disjoint 2x2 squares, then color remaining L triominoes by orientation.
    while True:
        found=None
        for r,c in sorted(cells):
            s={(r,c),(r+1,c),(r,c+1),(r+1,c+1)}
            if s<=cells: found=s; break
        if not found: break
        for r,c in found: out[r][c]=1
        cells-=found
    colors={(0,0):2,(0,1):4,(1,0):3,(1,1):2}
    while cells:
        r,c=min(cells)
        shape=None
        for dr in (0,-1):
          for dc in (0,-1):
            box={(r+dr,c+dc),(r+dr+1,c+dc),(r+dr,c+dc+1),(r+dr+1,c+dc+1)}
            part=box&cells
            if len(part)==3 and (r,c) in part:
              shape=(box,part); break
          if shape: break
        if not shape: break
        box,part=shape; missing=next(iter(box-part)); mr,mc=missing
        # orientation color determined by missing corner
        col=colors[(mr-min(x for x,y in box),mc-min(y for x,y in box))]
        for rr,cc in part: out[rr][cc]=col
        cells-=part
    return out
'''
